items.expected: Track states by their physical character when comparing geometry or method changes; a root number alone is not an identity. Define every charge-transfer or localization metric and its normalization. A claimed relaxation pathway needs evidence appropriate to its energy, coupling and environmental assumptions.

Establish a quantitative and physically identified excited-state picture for the bounded molecular series with native response evidence and explicit geometry/medium. The number of roots and representation are chosen for the claim, not matched to a reference list.

items.statement: Evidence that distinguishes the claimed explanation
items.expected: Assess pathway explanations using discriminating evidence relevant to the claimed mechanism. State character, accessibility and coupling evidence must be distinguished from a demonstrated rate; valid alternatives to author NTO/IFCT analysis are accepted.

Address assignment and numerical/model uncertainty sufficient for the conclusion; show whether substitution trends survive the uncertainties actually relevant to the chosen study. Repeated root indices across calculations are not a correspondence test. Source CT/LE pairs with inconsistent sums are not numerical targets; inspect metric definitions and normalization.
